verses.zh: 行为纯正的贫穷人胜过乖谬愚妄的富足人。
verses.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
verses.en: Better to be poor and honest than to be a rich fool who twists his words.

verses.zh: 心无知识的，乃为不善；脚步急快的，难免犯罪。
verses.kjv: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
verses.en: Being eager without knowing anything is not good, and rushing your feet makes you miss the way.

verses.zh: 人的愚昧倾败他的道；他的心也抱怨耶和华。
verses.kjv: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
verses.en: A person's own foolishness wrecks their life, and then their heart blames the LORD.

verses.zh: 财物使朋友增多；但穷人朋友远离。
verses.kjv: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
verses.en: Money brings many friends, but a poor person's friends leave.

verses.zh: 作假见证的，必不免受罚；吐出谎言的，终不能逃脱。
verses.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
verses.en: A false witness will not go unpunished, and whoever pours out lies will not get away.

verses.zh: 好施散的，有多人求他的恩情；爱送礼的，人都为他的朋友。
verses.kjv: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
verses.en: Many people beg favours from an important person, and everyone is a friend to someone who gives gifts.

verses.zh: 贫穷人，弟兄都恨他；何况他的朋友，更远离他！他用言语追随，他们却走了。
verses.kjv: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
verses.en: A poor person's own family dislikes him — how much more his friends stay away! He calls after them, but they are gone.

verses.zh: 得着智慧的，爱惜生命；保守聪明的，必得好处。
verses.kjv: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
verses.en: Whoever gets wisdom loves their own life; whoever holds on to understanding will do well.

verses.zh: 作假见证的，不免受罚；吐出谎言的，也必灭亡。
verses.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
verses.en: A false witness will not go unpunished, and whoever pours out lies will be destroyed.

verses.zh: 愚昧人宴乐度日是不合宜的；何况仆人管辖王子呢？
verses.kjv: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.en: Luxury does not suit a fool — and it suits a servant ruling over princes even less.

verses.zh: 人有见识就不轻易发怒；宽恕人的过失便是自己的荣耀。
verses.kjv: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
verses.en: Good sense makes a person slow to get angry, and it is to their credit to let a wrong go.

verses.zh: 王的忿怒好像狮子吼叫；他的恩典却如草上的甘露。
verses.kjv: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
verses.en: A king's anger is like a lion roaring, but his kindness is like dew on the grass.

verses.zh: 愚昧的儿子是父亲的祸患；妻子的争吵如雨连连滴漏。
verses.kjv: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
verses.en: A foolish son is his father's disaster, and a quarrelling wife is like a tap that keeps dripping.

verses.zh: 房屋钱财是祖宗所遗留的；惟有贤慧的妻是耶和华所赐的。
verses.kjv: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
verses.en: A house and money are passed down from parents, but a sensible wife comes from the LORD.

verses.zh: 懒惰使人沉睡；懈怠的人必受饥饿。
verses.kjv: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.en: Being lazy puts a person into a deep sleep, and a slack person goes hungry.

verses.zh: 谨守诫命的，保全生命；轻忽己路的，必致死亡。
verses.kjv: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
verses.en: Keeping the commands keeps your life safe, but ignoring your own way leads to death.

verses.zh: 怜悯贫穷的，就是借给耶和华；他的善行，耶和华必偿还。
verses.kjv: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
verses.en: Being kind to a poor person is like lending to the LORD, and he will pay back the good that was done.

verses.zh: 趁有指望，管教你的儿子；你的心不可任他死亡。
verses.kjv: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
verses.en: Correct your child while there is still hope; do not give up on him.

verses.zh: 暴怒的人必受刑罚；你若救他，必须再救。
verses.kjv: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
verses.en: A hot-tempered person must face the consequences; if you rescue him once, you will have to do it again.

verses.zh: 你要听劝教，受训诲，使你终久有智慧。
verses.kjv: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
verses.en: Listen to advice and take teaching, so that in the end you will be wise.

verses.zh: 人心多有计谋；惟有耶和华的筹算才能立定。
verses.kjv: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
verses.en: People make many plans in their hearts, but it is the LORD's purpose that stands.

verses.zh: 施行仁慈的，令人爱慕；穷人强如说谎言的。
verses.kjv: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.en: What people want in someone is kindness, and it is better to be poor than to be a liar.

verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华的，得着生命；他必恒久知足，不遭祸患。
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
verses.en: Respecting the LORD leads to life; you will rest content and not be visited by trouble.

verses.zh: 懒惰人放手在盘子里，就是向口撤回，他也不肯。
verses.kjv: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.en: A lazy person puts his hand in the dish and will not even lift it back to his mouth.

verses.zh: 鞭打亵慢人，愚蒙人必长见识；责备明哲人，他就明白知识。
verses.kjv: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
verses.en: Punish someone who sneers and the simple will learn caution; correct a person who understands and he will learn even more.

verses.zh: 虐待父亲、撵出母亲的，是贻羞致辱之子。
verses.kjv: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
verses.en: Whoever mistreats his father and drives away his mother is a son who brings shame and disgrace.

verses.zh: 我儿，不可听了教训而又偏离知识的言语。
verses.kjv: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
verses.en: My son, stop listening to teaching that turns you away from words of knowledge.

verses.zh: 匪徒作见证戏笑公平；恶人的口吞下罪孽。
verses.kjv: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
verses.en: A worthless witness laughs at what is fair, and a bad person's mouth swallows down wrongdoing.

verses.zh: 刑罚是为亵慢人预备的；鞭打是为愚昧人的背预备的。
verses.kjv: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
verses.en: Punishments are ready for those who sneer, and beatings for the backs of fools.
